title: Fix unauthorized error on chunked upload start

requirements.text: Fix the backend `startUpload` function so that it correctly identifies authenticated callers. The current access control check is rejecting legitimate upload requests with 'Unauthorized: Only users can start uploads'. Inspect the caller identity check in the `startUpload` handler — ensure it accepts any non-anonymous principal (i.e., a real Internet Identity user) rather than applying an overly restrictive check such as comparing against a hardcoded admin principal or using a broken identity comparison. The fix must allow authenticated Internet Identity users to call `startUpload`, `uploadChunk`, and `finalizeUpload` successfully.

quotes: Failed to start upload: Unauthorized: Only users can start uploads

acceptanceCriteria: An authenticated Internet Identity user can call startUpload without receiving an Unauthorized error.
An anonymous (unauthenticated) caller is still rejected with an appropriate error.
uploadChunk and finalizeUpload succeed for an authenticated caller after a successful startUpload.
A 0.39 MB PDF can be uploaded end-to-end without authorization errors.

requirements.text: Verify that the frontend actor in `useActor.ts` / `useQueries.ts` is constructed with the authenticated identity (not anonymous) when the user is logged in via Internet Identity before calling `startUpload`. If the actor is being created anonymously even when the user is authenticated, ensure it is rebuilt with the correct identity so the backend receives a non-anonymous principal.

quotes: Failed to start upload: Unauthorized: Only users can start uploads

acceptanceCriteria: After login via Internet Identity, the actor used for upload calls carries the authenticated principal.
The startUpload call is made with the authenticated actor, not an anonymous one.
No Unauthorized error appears in the browser console during a PDF upload attempt by a logged-in user.

constraints: Do not change the chunked upload API surface (startUpload, uploadChunk, finalizeUpload, getPdfChunks, getPdfChunk, listPdfs, deletePdf, renamePdf).
Do not modify files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts or frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts directly — propose safe alternatives if frontend actor construction needs adjustment.
Preserve all existing metadata fields: title, shareId, uploadTimestamp.
nonGoals: Changing the chunked upload chunk size or retry logic.
Modifying the PDF viewer or dashboard pages.
Altering the visual theme or UI layout.
